note_en: 还不如 introduces the option the speaker prefers after a less attractive one has been mentioned, like English "might as well" or "would rather": 如果说实话，妈妈肯定又要唠叨半天，还不如说句谎话让她安心 "if he told the truth, Mom would nag for ages, so he might as well tell a little lie to put her mind at ease." It often pairs with 与其 or 比起, as in 比起让父母…赶几百公里的路…他还不如一个人把病扛过去 "rather than make his parents travel hundreds of kilometers, he'd sooner tough it out alone."
